summary.text: Rachel Roarx is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 38 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Republican Carrie Sanders McKeehan.
She previously worked as a Louisville Metro Government legislative aide.

paragraphs.text: Rachel Roarx was born in Louisville, Kentucky, graduated from Holy Cross High School in 2015, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Louisville in 2019.

Her career experience includes working as a neighborhood initiatives manager with the Louisville Independent Business Alliance, executive director of the Southwest Dream Team, and a legislative aide with the Louisville Metro Government.
She has served as board president of The Little Loomhouse and Louisville Girls Leadership.
Roarx succeeded Democrat McKenzie Cantrell in District 38.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Families and Children, House Local Government, Postsecondary Education and House Transportation committees.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Roarx's profile said she ran for office as a voice for labor, first responders, healthcare, safety, infrastructure and the Southend of Louisville.
